detail.title: Compost ledger: turn retired Hodge routes into reusable constraints
detail.description:
Maintain the research compost pile.

For every retired, failed, corrected, or heuristic Hodge/W114 route, record:

1. Original hypothesis/ansatz.
2. Exact reason it failed or was superseded.
3. Smallest valid negative conclusion.
4. Reusable mathematical residue:
   * exclusion criterion,
   * invariant,
   * counterexample,
   * normalization correction,
   * projector/sign convention,
   * search-space pruning rule,
   * regression test,
   * or candidate condition for the next family.
5. What would be required to revive the route.
6. Link to the original preserved evidence.

Initial compost:

* naive 3+3 simple surface-divisor tensors -> bounded partition/Hodge obstruction;
* support-≤2 rank-3 homogeneous Koszul family -> zero W114 coefficient in that family;
* pair-separated quadratic-twisted Tate-plane lift -> no residual-character support;
* raw q=7-zeta_3 sign -> corrected to 3(7-zeta_3);
* reversed plane projector orientation -> corrected homological convention;
* arithmetic-sign/geometric-direction receipt mapping -> regression-tested correction;
* 35+35 / K5 / visualization analogies -> heuristic only until an explicit Hodge comparison map exists.

Acceptance: nothing leaves the active spine without yielding a concise reusable residue.
